note_manual: 2026-11-12 — published version (Granular Matter 17 (2015) 83–93; 11 PDF pages = printed p.83–93, PDF page = printed page − 82). Tool crops 15: kept 5, re-cut 10 (see missing_labels_resolved). Hand crops 43: panels 10 (Fig. 5 close-ups, 6a–c, 9a–b, 10a–b, 11a–b; vector pages rendered at 400 dpi), equations 9 (Eqs. (1)–(9), display equation with its number only, 400 dpi), evidence paragraphs 24 (300 dpi, one text column each). All re-cut and hand crops = ink bounding box of a region bounded by blank bands, rendered exactly and pasted on a white canvas with a uniform margin (5–6 pt), so no neighbouring line can enter. The first render of the hand crops used a page clip with a margin and the Eq. (3) crop caught the top of Eq. (4) (the two equations are 3.6 pt apart) — all crops were re-rendered with the canvas method before viewing. All 58 crops opened with Read. Printed inconsistencies visible in the crops: Eq. (6) last subscript 'k_kwp2'; Eq. (8) writes a stiffness difference while the text and the conclusions subtract displacements at equal force; p.86 text 'RMin = 0.552 nm and RMax = 0.571 nm' vs Table 3 −0.552 / 0.571 µm; p.87 one sentence printed twice around 'The exact dimensions are given in'; p.91 'k = 2.0 − 3.25 × 10^−6 N m^−1', '2.8 × 10^−6', '5.1 × 10^−6' (Fig. 9b / 10b axes: 10^6 N m^−1); Table 4 cylinder for 3 mm beads H = 0.0042 m = 1.4 d (text: 1.5 d) and inner diameters +6.7 % / +20 % / +37.5 % (text: about 7 %).
key_note: manual keys: f5r = right-column close-ups of Fig. 5, f<N><panel> = panel crop of Fig. N (panel_of), e01–e09 = Eqs. (1)–(9) (kind 'equation'), x<PDF page><letter> = evidence paragraph (kind 'text'); page = PDF page (printed page = PDF page + 82)

digitized.method: Fig. 6a–c, 7, 8, 9a–b, 10a–b, 11a–b are vector graphics: marker bounding-box centres, dash / dot segments and Bezier samples of the plotted curves were read from the page drawing paths (PyMuPDF get_drawings) and mapped to data units through two major grid lines per axis (frame positions reproduce the printed axis limits within 0.02 %); legend samples excluded by the legend box. Half-filled cycle markers (Fig. 9) = mean of the two half shapes. Raw error-bar lines of Fig. 7 (160) are summarised in one row. Derived checks in the card: plotted stiffness values equal the secant F/δ of the force-displacement data (not the tangent dF/dδ); polynomial curves in Fig. 6 are Fn = aδ² + bδ + c.
